222-527-4247-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

512-1719-3814.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-3814.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-1719-3814.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

3560-5972-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-5972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1006-3713-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Wolfhunter's Quiver by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-6723-6965.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1251-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1251-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1251-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2604-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken colorless creature.
You control at least four Equipment.
2604-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the colorless creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Plate Armor's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ugin.
Repeat.

618-3835-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {R} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2187-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2187-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
2187-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

3605-4050-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3581-7109-7296.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-7109-7296.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

1978-2416-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-2416-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Rise and Shine.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-6751-6754-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-6751-6754-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-6751-6754-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

236-1978-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Bring to Life.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
236-1978-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

777-2034-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-647-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-647-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

224-1525-3848-6628.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least seven lands.
224-1525-3848-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control, and then causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Repeat.

394-856-2981-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2-2034-5554-6441.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

625-1651-4321-5251.description:
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2561-4231-4559.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating a Food token, a Clue token, and a Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifact tokens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1449-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Plundering Barbarian triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Plundering Barbarian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Plundering Barbarian token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

710-3967-5617.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

232-2232-2537-3604.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Priest of Urabrask to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Priest of Urabrask onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cadric trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghalta with haste.
When the Ghalta token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ghalta token's trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-1558-1908-4690.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic lands.
1379-1558-1908-4690.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Phylath with haste.
Put the Phylath token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phylath token enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1046-1479-2907.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-2907.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the first Scute Swarm trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

91-4762-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-4762-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3062-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3062-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3062-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2587-4067.description:
Activate Urza's Blueprints by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Urza's Blueprints.
Repeat.

1661-1987-4423-5034.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
